issue.title: Decide and implement NBSP normalization for capture input
issue.description: Approved plan plan:202608/capture_paste_plain_text.md left NBSP normalization out of the Cmd-V plain-text paste fix. Web copies can contain U+00A0; because it is not an ASCII space, marker parsing such as @route, s:<N>, and p:<N> can look right but route wrong. Scope: decide whether pasted-only or all capture input should fold NBSP to space across bob-cli and bob-mac-capture, implement the chosen grammar behavior, and cover marker parsing tests.
